releaseTitle: SOREX / Swarix v2.9 – Dolby Atmos & Concert DSP, AI Recommendation, Smart Typo & Lyrics Search
changelog:
1. Dolby Atmos 3D Spatial & Concert Hall Live Arena DSP Modes in Equalizer
2. Advanced Hybrid AI Music Recommendation Engine (Content-Based + Collaborative + User Taste Profile + Session Context)
3. Strict Language & Mood Consistency (Hindi Romantic -> Hindi Romantic, never abruptly jumping to clashing genres)
4. Fixed Listening History & Search Separation: typing/displaying search results never creates history records; only actual playback records ID, duration, completion %, and skip status
5. Multilingual & Devanagari Lyrics-Based Search Engine with matched lyric snippet display
6. Typo-Tolerant Smart Search Engine (Levenshtein distance <= 2)
7. Upgraded Microphone Voice Search with RECORD_AUDIO permission and Hindi/English speech recognition
8. Extensible Query-by-Humming / Audio Fingerprint Provider Interface
